ordinances.name: Rezone Up
ordinances.text: The chosen district goes up one zoning level.

ordinances.name: Downzone
ordinances.text: The chosen district goes down one zoning level. Buildings already there stay (grandfathering).

ordinances.name: Hotel Permit Expansion
ordinances.text: Add 4 hotel permits to the supply.

ordinances.name: Skyscraper Permit Expansion
ordinances.text: Add 2 skyscraper permits to the supply.

ordinances.name: Building Moratorium
ordinances.text: Nobody can build anywhere for 2 rounds.

ordinances.name: Rent Control
ordinances.text: Rents in the chosen district are 25% lower for 3 rounds.

ordinances.name: Tourism Boost
ordinances.text: Rents in the chosen district are 25% higher for 3 rounds.

ordinances.name: Transit Investment
ordinances.text: Railroad rents are 50% higher for 3 rounds.

ordinances.name: Property Tax Hike
ordinances.text: Every player pays $10 for each building level they own, right away.

ordinances.name: Infrastructure Bond
ordinances.text: Every player pays $50. The lowest-zoned district goes up one level (the agenda setter breaks ties).

ordinances.name: Historic Preservation
ordinances.text: The chosen district's zoning can never change again.

ordinances.name: Casino Regulation
ordinances.text: Casino bets and Dice Duel stakes are capped at $200 for 4 rounds.

ordinances.name: Public Works
ordinances.text: Every hidden Government tile is revealed.
